messages:
Priya Shah: quick triage — 52 open tickets, 2 P1s (auth flake + dedupe bug), 9 P2s. Overall backlog +4 vs yesterday. Known: login 502s still flapping since ~03:00 UTC. Macros updated: auth-timeout-retry and basic-escstep (see below).

Liam Chen: on the 502s now, seeing a spike in redis timeouts correlated with pod restarts. I'm rolling a cache-fallback tweak to prod-1 (will post when done).

Marcus Rivera: taking the dedupe P1 repro. Need full logs from user 1234 — @Priya can you paste the ticket link?

Priya Shah: here — https://tickets.internal/RED-5789 — user says duplicates happen on retry path, attached request IDs.

Jenny Park: coverage note — I'll handle queue 2 (chargebacks + macros) from 10:00–14:00 PDT today. If anyone can't cover their shift pls call it out.

Ellen (oncall): rolling a new macro 'slow-embed-backoff' to reduce retry storms for transient embedding errors. Should cut noise by ~60%.

support-bot: Automated: macro 'auth-timeout-retry' v1.2 deployed by Jenny Park at 1791034100.

Marcus Rivera: small ask — MR #2684 fixes dedupe logic and adds a guarded path for retries. @Liam @Jenny can one of you review? low-risk.

Liam Chen: will review in ~15m. quick skim looks good. :thumbsup:

Priya Shah: blockers — need infra confirmation that Redis failover finished before we close the login 502 P1. Also need user confirmation for dedupe fix repro (Marcus).

Ellen (oncall): failover completed at 1791034550, metrics stable for 5m and error rate back to baseline. I'm +1 to close the P1 once the user verifies.

Jenny Park: FYI, updated macro snippets (paste below) — follow them when responding to customers to ensure we collect request_id and env.

Jenny Park: ```
- Macro: auth-timeout-retry
  Steps:
  1) Collect request_id and timestamp
  2) Ask for last 3 attempts + environment
  3) Suggest temporary workaround: clear cache or toggle fallback
```

Marcus Rivera: noted. I'll ask the user for logs and link the macro in the ticket.

Priya Shah: final notes: ticket volume trending slightly up; main pain points: transient cache failures and a small regression in dedupe logic. If anyone hits capacity, call backup @Jenny. Next async check at 18:00 UTC.

Liam Chen: thanks team — redeploy to prod-1 finished, monitoring.

Jenny Park: I'll grab postmortem template if we need one.

support-bot: Reminder: daily triage summary will be posted to #operations at 18:05 UTC.
